title: Color Palettes Curated by delphi.tools
text: palette name uses lowercase letters hyphens. example, use "mayfair" "grand-budapest". delphi_palette() returns character vector hexadecimal colors. print_delphi_palette() draws palette.  Set direction = -1 reverse color order. Set n return first colors selected order. Set type = "continuous" interpolate palette. must also set n.
code: delphi_palette("mayfair") #> [1] "#1a2634" "#2d4a3e" "#6b1c2a" "#c9b896" "#f5f0e6" print_delphi_palette("mayfair") delphi_palette("grand-budapest", direction = -1) #> [1] "#f0c040" "#7b2d5b" "#f5e6d3" "#9c4070" "#d4658f" delphi_palette("pride", n = 3) #> [1] "#e40303" "#ff8c00" "#ffed00" continuous <- delphi_palette("mayfair", n = 20, type = "continuous") continuous #>  [1] "#1A2634" "#1E2D36" "#223538" "#263C3A" "#2A443C" "#30473C" "#3D3D38" #>  [8] "#4A3434" "#572A30" "#64202C" "#742C35" "#884D4C" "#9C6E62" "#B08E79" #> [15] "#C4AF90" "#CFC0A2" "#D9CCB3" "#E2D8C4" "#EBE4D5" "#F5F0E6"

text: scale_color_delphi_d() scale_fill_delphi_d() map factor levels palette colors. factor levels colors, scales interpolate colors. scale_color_delphi_c() scale_fill_delphi_c() map numeric values palette colors. scale_colour_delphi_d() scale_colour_delphi_c() use British spelling.
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(iris, aes(Species, Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +   geom_boxplot() +   scale_fill_delphi_d("pride") +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.position = "none") ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color = Petal.Length)) +   geom_point(size = 2) +   scale_color_delphi_c("mayfair") +   theme_minimal()
